newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Avimo sees Singapore sales doubling.
newsitem.headline: Avimo sees Singapore sales doubling.

text.p: Singapore's Avimo Electro Optics Pte Ltd, a unit of Avimo Group Ltd, expects to double sales from its Singapore plant to S$80 million by the year 2000, managing director Avi Ayalon said on Monday
Ayalon told reporters Avimo Electro Optics was investing another S$14 million to extend its Singapore plant and upgrade technology over the next three years.
The company had invested S$6.0 million between 1994 and 1996, he said.
"In 1994, we sold $23 million and sales started to pick up to $40 million in 1996. And I intend to be $80 million in year 2000," Ayalon said.
He said the Singapore plant now produced 140,000 optical components a month. Ayalon said he saw this rising to 200,000 components per month in less than 18 months.
The company's growth strategies included joint ventures, partnerships with European and Japanese companies and technology development, he said.

In 1996, 30 percent of the Singapore plant's output was for the commercial market and 70 percent for the military. This would move towards 45 percent for the commercial market and 55 percent for the military by 2000, he said.
For financial year 1996 ended September 30, sales turnover was S$118 million.
